info.title: zxvd JSON-RPC
info.description: zxvd-rpc/1: JSON-RPC 2.0, one request per line over a 0600 UNIX socket owned by the same user (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h). Errors: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request or batch, -32601 unknown method, -32602 bad params, -32603 internal, -32000 libzxv status: error.data = {status: ZXV_E_* number, name: its symbolic name, class: USAGE|REFUSED|FATAL|SYSTEM}, -32010 peer request refused or failed (message says why), -32012 the method's feature is off (zxvd_ext.h X4: start zxvd with --enable FEATURE or call features.set), -32011 AIPI call refused or failed (message: the AIPI_ERR_* name and what it means), -32020 payment step refused (message says why: netting, passkey or escrow, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_pay.h), -32080 seat refused (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_seats.c: the message starts with the seats.h status name, e.g. SEAT_ERR_DENIED; a wrong login or a back-off is a result of seats.unlock, not an error), -32070 no companion yet (companion.*: the swarm has no agents). -32072 the chiglet's name refused, already given, not available or not kept (companion.name*; message: the chg_name.h CHGN_E_* code, then why). -32071 the organ could not answer (swarm.organ). 64-bit integers (entry ids, *_minor results) travel as decimal strings. zxvd refuses to start against libzxv older than ABI 1.3. -32090 Web4 feed operation refused (message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_web4.c). -32095 power tracking is not running or the budget target is unknown (power.*, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_power.h). -32096 the IRC gateway refused (irc.*; message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_irc.h). -32097 a jurisdiction install or tax rate refused (jurisdiction.install, jurisdiction.tax_rate; message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h J6-J9). -32032 a public space or watch hall request refused (pspace.*, hall.*; message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_pspace.h). -32014 files.* refused (message: zxf_strerror, kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_files.h). -32013 space refused: no such space, this node's role in it may not do that, or its governance refuses the step (kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_spaces.h S1, S4). Paired phones reach the same methods over the phone link (phone.link or zxvd --phone-link, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_phone.h): zxvd.shutdown, peer.serve, jurisdiction.set, jurisdiction.install, aipi.put, aipi.publish, aipi.execute, phone.*, features.set, files.*, spaces.*, play.run, play.draft, the people methods (social.*, call.*, xlate.*, devmesh.*, ui.*), sys.*, log.tail, journal.*, screen.*, place.*, search.*, print.*, scan.*, backup.* and every method group are refused there with -32015, and net.command, peer.ask, currency.enable, ledger.open_account and ledger.post too unless the pairing allows posting. -32016 Playground call refused or failed (message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h P1-P3). -32030 a people method (social.*, call.*, xlate.*, devmesh.*, ui.*) refused or failed (message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_people.h). -32031 xlate.translate: no local model can generate (nothing is invented). -32022 printer or scanner refused or unreachable (print.*, scan.*; kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_print_host.h): the message says why. -32018 backup refused (backup.*; kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_keepsake.h): the destination is not usable, a snapshot or a kept copy is missing or damaged, or there is no such snapshot; the message says which. -32019 screen time refused (screen.*; kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_screen.h): the guardian's passphrase is wrong or missing, too many wrong tries, no such limit, no room, or the file could not be written; the message says which. -32021 place refused (place.*; kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_place.h): no such place, a name taken, no room, or the file could not be written; the message says which. -32017 a module method (freight.*, harmonic.*, stream.*, ehop.*, web4.*) refused well-formed input: too few rows, a hash or AEAD tag that does not verify (message says why; zxvd_rpc_modules.h). Bytes travel as hex strings (*_hex). -32040 a card operation the issuer refused (zxvd_cards). -32041 a passkey ceremony refused (zxvd_ident). -32050 a vault, swap, auction, Zenny or stats engine refused (message: its status name). -32060 a bond, derivative, grant, estate or money engine (mint, qnote, fx, vhub, capmkt, market, royalty, cred, dispute) refused (message: <STATUS>: why). -32085 a file fabrication step refused (fab.*; message "<FAB status>: why", kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_fab.h B12). -32023 a shell job refused: shell.* off, no such job, a bad folder, or no room (zxvd_shell.h). -32024 journal.append: no journal, no audit key, or the disk refused the entry. -32025 a capability answer refused: no room, the answers file could not be written, or no answer to take back (zxv_caps.h). -32026 a name lookup or DID refused: dns.* off, too many lookups waiting, or a DID that does not decode (zxvd_dns.h). -32027 a schedule refused: no room, the file could not be written, or no such schedule (zxv_sched.h). -32028 a process refused: process control off, a process zxvd does not act on, or one that is gone (zxvd_proc.h).

methods.name: swarm.earnings
methods.summary: The swarm's own-device credit in the owner's books (docs/ZXVD.md, zxvd_rpc.h E1-E6). Own-device work never earns VFV: the mirror is a private unit, SWC by default, and VFV or an ISO 4217 currency is refused (E6). After every settled market cycle the owner's account is set to the Financial capital (SWC) the owner's models hold, times rate_minor, by one balanced posting from or to the swarm market account. The accounts are null until the first settled cycle. With a books file (--books), accounts brought back at start keep their balance: the run's first cycle is the base and later cycles post only the change (E5). Books holding an older VFV mirror have its balance posted back to the market account at start as 'vfv reversal N' (E6).

currency.description: Private unit of the mirror (default SWC, 2 minor units; --earnings-ccy); never VFV or an ISO 4217 currency (E6)

rate_minor.description: Minor units per SWC (--earnings-rate); a bookkeeping rate, not a market price

resumed.description: The accounts came back from the books file (E5)

vfv_reversed_minor.description: VFV taken back from an older own-device mirror when the books opened (E6); usually 0
